packageRules.description: Keep eslint-config-next in lockstep with next. Majors (also for eslint) need Dependency Dashboard approval; approve them together when upgrading Next.js, since eslint-config-next 16 and ESLint 10 require Next 16.

Each pnpm override key pins one major line (e.g. brace-expansion@1 for minimatch@3) to a patched floor. Bumping its target to another major swaps in an incompatible API under the old consumers, so only allow updates within the same major.
